calls.summary:
# Chicago MeasureCamp Post Event Debrief
Date: 2026-09-24 | Duration: 41m

## Summary
The team discussed ways to improve event engagement and sales outreach, focusing on the difficulty of securing customer speakers and the need for marketing-led incentives such as contests and awards. Swag will be tiered, with useful lower-cost items for broad audiences and premium gifts for qualified leads; logo visibility, open presentation, packaging, and cost control also require refinement. Poor booth placement, limited organizer support, weekend timing, and missing lead scanners reduced traffic, prompting ideas such as event announcements and improved booth positioning. Lead capture methods are being tested, including informal entry and a transparent live drawing wheel connected to Google Sheets, with Apple AirPods Max selected as the giveaway prize. The team also plans clearer event documentation, daily onsite updates, simpler analytic-focused booth messaging, and greater emphasis on speaking opportunities over booth sponsorship. An executive dinner for about 20 attendees is being planned, with The Vault favored as the venue and three London attendees confirmed.

## Keywords
swag strategy, customer engagement, giveaway prizes, event booth traffic, marketing communication, lead capture

## Action Items

**Lyndsie Berens**
Organize a company-wide strategy meeting to address challenges in securing customer speakers for events and improve customer engagement in marketing efforts (00:00)
Follow up on Reach Desk demo to explore awards and gifting options for giveaways and swag (01:58)
Improve swag branding by increasing logo size and visibility, especially on small items like charging spinners (04:04)
Coordinate a tiered swag strategy for the upcoming AI conference and other future events, balancing high-end items for qualified leads and lower-cost swag for general attendees (10:00)
Test and refine swag selections for 2027 events based on trial results and attendee feedback (12:27)
Redesign giveaway prize choices to focus on Apple AirPods Max headphones as the preferred grand prize for broader appeal (24:59)
Develop and implement a live giveaway drawing system using Google Sheets and a branded wheel to enhance event engagement and transparency (19:38)
Enhance Notion documentation by adding event-specific labels and clearer naming conventions to differentiate travel and communication plans, reducing confusion (14:35)
Share event travel and communication plans with the team well ahead of events to ensure preparedness and coordination (16:23)
Rework booth messaging to simplify and clarify product differentiators, coordinating with the product marketing team to tailor messaging for event audiences (26:58)
Aggregate expense reports and cost data post-events to analyze ROI and inform future event investments (29:48)
Manage logistics for the San Francisco executive dinner, including confirming a smaller venue with a 20-person limit and flexible options based on expected attendance (30:08)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Lead marketing team discussion to devise improved strategies for connecting with customers for event speaking slots and nominations (01:02)
Support initiatives to amplify booth engagement including live giveaway and creative swag ideas (19:06)
Agree on giveaway prize selection and help communicate and promote the preferred prize (Apple AirPods Max) (24:59)
Collect feedback on product-led communication during events, affirming current communication frequency as effective (25:18)
Participate in planning for securing speaking slots instead of booth sponsorship at future events to increase visibility and ROI (29:22)

**Graham McNicoll**
Provide feedback on booth signage and customer reception to marketing messaging to improve clarity and effectiveness (26:00)
Evaluate giveaway methods and recommend capturing leads through informal channels like LinkedIn connections (17:52)
Share photos of competitors’ booth designs and giveaways to inform future booth strategy and improve engagement (26:05)
Advise on giveaway prize preference favoring headphones or watch based on cost and appeal judgments to guide prize selection (23:53)
Assist in expense reporting and ROI evaluations post-event to ensure accurate tracking of event costs and benefits (29:48)

**Liz Fox**
Contribute insights on swag usefulness and attendee behaviors concerning giveaways to optimize swag strategy (03:05)
Recommend engagement tactics including in-event announcements and booth placements to increase booth traffic and attendee interaction (08:05)
Collaborate on clarifying lead capture goals and supporting giveaway and lead collection strategies to maximize event effectiveness (16:45)
